headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises SolarSquare on $53 million Series C fundraise
sum: SolarSquare Energy, India's full-stack residential solar platform, raised $53 million in Series C funding led by B Capital, with co-investment from Lightspeed, Lowercarbon Capital, Good Capital, Zerodha and Better Capital. Fresh capital earmarked for city expansion and tech capability across its 150+ MW installed capacity platform serving ~50,000 homes.
implication: Series C in capital-intensive renewable energy requires comprehensive vendor legal due diligence alongside standard VC equity documentation—a critical structuring layer for hardware-backed energy platforms.
detail: SolarSquare operates India's full-stack residential solar platform with 150+ MW installed capacity across 29 cities in 9 states, serving approximately 50,000 homes and 400 housing societies. The deal is structured around the company's proven design-install-maintain recurring revenue model. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas executed comprehensive equity documentation including share subscription, shareholders' agreement, purchase agreements, founders' employment pacts, and ancillary documents, plus vendor legal due diligence—standard VC practice but critical given the hardware-heavy nature of renewable energy.
